summary: A self-playing minimalist ensemble in the manner of 1960s to 80s minimal music: repeating figures, slow chord cycles and audible processes that you can steer, rearrange and record.
features: Four models: ARPEGGIO, PHASE, PATTERNS and BELLS; twenty built-in pieces
EASY keys: each white key plays a chord in the key
EDIT rolls new ideas per part; teach it your own chord cycle
Bring parts in and out by hand; processes like grow, shrink, shift
Records performances as songs, up to eight saved
Newer FM-1s with the UC25HQ80 flash need version 0.2.2 or later
